F1.name: API Latency +150ms
F1.description: Istio fault injection: +150ms fixed delay on /v1/properties
F1.notes: Measured during 15min Istio VirtualService fault injection + k6 brownout test (100 VUs). P95 under 500ms target. Error rate well under 1%. Recovery took 55s (backlog drain excellent).

F2.name: Packet Loss 30%
F2.notes: Measured during 10min Istio packet loss + k6 spike test (0→500 VUs). Circuit breaker opened at 2min mark, transitioned to half-open at 7min. P95 under 2000ms target. Error rate stayed under 30% threshold. Recovery took 75s (CB half-open → closed slightly slow).

F3.name: Redis Brownout +200ms
F3.description: Chaos Mesh NetworkChaos: +200ms latency ±50ms jitter on Redis pods
F3.notes: Measured during 10min Chaos Mesh network latency experiment. Cache hit rate dropped from 85% → 72% during fault. P95 under 800ms target. No cache fallback errors detected. Recovery took 115s (cache warming after latency removed).

F4.name: Redis Pod Kill
F4.description: Chaos Mesh PodChaos: One-shot pod termination (Redis primary)
F4.notes: Redis Sentinel detected failure at 3s, promoted replica at 7s, connection pool reconnected at 9s. Brief 5xx spike during failover (<1%). P95 met target. Failover time 9s under 10s target - excellent.

F5.name: Kafka Throttle 50%
F5.description: Manual Kafka quota: 50% bandwidth reduction on consumer group
F5.notes: Consumer lag grew from 0 → 6500 messages during throttle. Backpressure handled gracefully (no message loss confirmed). Lag clearance took 280s after throttle removed (under 300s target). P95 under 1000ms during backpressure. No data integrity issues detected.

F6.name: DB Read-Replica Stall +250ms
F6.description: Manual ToxiProxy latency: +250ms on PostgreSQL read replica
F6.notes: Connection pool detected replica latency at 20s mark, began routing reads to primary at 60s. Write P95 remained steady at 120ms. Read P95 under 800ms target. Recovery took 110s (health check interval 30s + connection pool refresh 80s). Graceful degradation confirmed.

F7.name: API Pod Kill
F7.description: Chaos Mesh PodChaos: One-shot pod termination (1 of 3 API pods)
F7.notes: Pod killed at T=0. Kubernetes detected unhealthy pod at T=5s. HPA triggered new pod creation at T=10s. New pod ready at T=50s. Load rebalanced at T=55s. P95 under 600ms target during 2/3 capacity period. Error rate stayed under 1%. Recovery 55s (under 60s target - excellent).
